title: feat(l1fixed): after saturation L1 is the identity
science: Bounded_theorem note, no probe cell. HALT/FIXED-POINT structure of the displayed L1 kernel: the full lock set V and the empty set are BOTH fixed points, and growing five ticks from the seed gives locks_5 = locks_4 with F, rho(A), rho(B) and the tree-gauge phi all unchanged -- so the dynamics terminates at tick 4 and is thereafter the identity. Two absorbing states (all-locked and never-started) with no cycling. Minor: the F-unchanged check is implied by t5-equals-t4-locks, so it restates rather than tests. 25/25 runner PASS.
